Class CodecDeserializer<T>

java.lang.Object
org.jwcarman.codec.kafka.CodecDeserializer<T>
Type Parameters:
T - the value type
All Implemented Interfaces:
Closeable, AutoCloseable, org.apache.kafka.common.serialization.Deserializer<T>
public final class CodecDeserializer<T> extends Object implements org.apache.kafka.common.serialization.Deserializer<T>
Adapts a Codec to Kafka's Deserializer. The topic is ignored, and null — a tombstone — deserializes to null through Codec.nullSafe(). Everything else, including any exception the codec throws, passes through unchanged.

Kafka's reflective, no-arg configuration path (value.deserializer=...) cannot construct this class; hand instances to the consumer or ConsumerFactory directly.
